issue.title: gh --limit sweep (#4985) remainder: triage-area.py live_area_labels() caps the label list at 500
issue.body:
Same class as #5425/#4985, lower severity. `scripts/triage-area.py:495` reads the live label set with `gh label list --repo $REPO --limit 500 --json name`. `--limit` truncates SILENTLY, so past 500 repo labels a genuinely-existing `area:` label can be absent from the returned set; `live_area_labels()` then rejects it and the issue is left with no area rather than mislabelled. That is the fail-CLOSED direction, so it degrades quietly instead of mis-partitioning the frontier — but it is still an invisible, depth-conditional stall on a half-hourly cron. Suggested shape: `gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/$REPO/labels?per_page=100"` with a fail-closed ceiling, guarded in scripts/tests/test_triage_area.py alongside the existing no-silent-truncation tests.

> 🤖 Discovered by the SPARQ worker while implementing #5425. Out-of-scope for that PR; captured as follow-up.
